messages.text: Foggy morning, academic defense, and a night of improv
A foggy start to the day gives way to sunshine with a high near 81°F. Today features a dissertation defense at the University of Michigan and an improv show in Hamtramck.
Expect fog today with a high near 81°F and a low around 56°F; there is a 3% chance of precipitation.
Sunrise is at 7:52 AM, sunset at 6:46 PM, with the moon in its first quarter phase, 55.6% illuminated.

Attend the Diana Velazquez Dissertation Defense at 1100 North University Building in Ann Arbor at 9:00 AM, or catch IMPROV l Monday Night Improv w/ The Planet Ant Home Team at Black Box in Hamtramck at 7:30 PM.
A 862 Meeting is scheduled for Wednesday evening.
Van Buren Township approves data center plan

The Van Buren Township Planning Commission has approved the final site plan for the Project Cannoli Data Center, developed by Panattoni for Google. Preliminary construction has begun on the 282-acre site.
Looking ahead to the week's events
The Orionids meteor shower is expected to peak on Wednesday, October 21st. A full moon is anticipated on October 26th.
